AdminUser.description: A user as seen by the instance admin directory (isInstanceAdmin flag included).

isInstanceAdmin.description: Whether the user holds the instance_admin role.

Agent.description: An agent is an AI worker configured to run tasks on behalf of a company.

Approval.description: An approval request awaiting decision by a board actor.

AssetContent.description: Asset content envelope. Backed by pc-repos asset storage; binary payload is base64-encoded in `content`.

content.description: UTF-8 string for text assets, base64 for binary assets.

BridgeStream.description: Single frame exchanged over a plugin bridge stream. Frames may be client->server or server->client.

type.description: Frame type: hello, ping, data, ack, close.

Case.description: A case aggregates a unit of work across issues, docs, labels, and annotations.

Company.description: A company is the top-level tenant in Paperclip.

CompanyArtifact.description: A build artifact or work product attached to a company.

CompanyMember.description: A user's membership in a company, with optional user fields denormalised from a LEFT JOIN.

membershipRole.description: Role key within the company (e.g. owner, admin, member).

status.description: Whether the membership is active or archived.

CompanyOrgChart.description: Hierarchical org chart for a company's agents.

CompanyStatsList.description: Per-company stats for every company the caller can see.

CompanyTimelineResult.description: Work timeline spanning actors / spans / events / edges.

CsvExport.description: CSV export payload. `headers` are the column names in order; `csv` is the raw string content.

Decision.description: A decision awaiting or already resolved by an authorized actor.

DecisionEffect.description: A side-effect to be applied when the option is chosen.

DecisionOption.description: One option presented to the actor for selection.

DevServerRestart.description: Confirmation payload returned after triggering a dev-server restart.

ErrorResponse.description: Generic error body returned for 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 500 responses.

traceId.description: Distributed trace id for correlating this error with server logs.

FileResourceContent.description: File resource content envelope, scoped under an issue. Mirrors the upstream Paperclip shape.

Folder.description: A folder groups routines or skills. Supports nested hierarchy via `parentId`.

kind.description: Folder stores routines or skills; the two trees are independent.

slug.description: URL-safe slug, unique within a (company, kind, parent) scope.

Goal.description: A goal in the company goal hierarchy (mission / company / team / project / task).

Health.description: Service health snapshot returned by GET /api/health.

HeartbeatRun.description: A single heartbeat execution cycle for an agent.

Inbox.description: A user-scoped inbox dismissal or snooze state for an inbox item.

kind.description: `dismiss` is permanent until restore; `snooze` expires at `snoozedUntil`.

snoozedUntil.description: Required when kind=snooze; must be null when kind=dismiss.

Invite.description: An invite token that grants access to a company when accepted.

inviteType.description: open (anyone with link) or restricted (named recipients).

Issue.description: An issue is a unit of work tracked by Paperclip.

JsSource.description: JavaScript module body returned by GET /api/adapters/{type}/ui-parser.js.

LiveEventStream.description: Single event frame pushed over the company event stream.

PaginationCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor emitted by list endpoints. Pass back verbatim to fetch the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor token for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

totalCount.description: Optional total count when the backend can compute it cheaply (null otherwise).

Pipeline.description: A pipeline defines stage transitions for cases (issues being routed through a workflow).

Routine.description: A routine is a scheduled workflow triggered on a cron schedule or manually.

Session.description: Current authenticated session, including user identity and effective permissions.

UserProfile.description: Profile fields visible to the profile owner.

UserProfileUpdate.description: Subset of profile fields that the owner can mutate via PATCH /api/auth/profile.

ValidationErrorList.description: Wrapper for a list of field-level validation errors returned on HTTP 422.

traceId.description: Distributed trace id for correlating this error with server logs.

info.description: REST API for the Paperclip AI agent management platform
info.title: Paperclip API
